title: nazm.test/1
description: One test case from `nazm test --json`. A case is `NAME.nz` beside `NAME.expected`, or (Gate 2) a `@test` or `@fuzz` function; it runs interpreted and compiled, and both must produce the recorded output, or end as the function's expectation says. One object per line on stdout.

kind.description: Gate 2, additive: `golden` for a recorded output, `test` or `fuzz` for a marked function, named `STEM::FUNCTION`.

expected.description: The contents of the `.expected` file, trimmed; `passes` or `fails` for a marked function.

native.description: The compiled leg. `null` when `--interpret-only` was given.

output.description: Stdout and stderr combined and trimmed — a program's diagnostic is as much of its behaviour as its value.
